findings.title: q=+1 staging record conflicts with the current production-run provenance state
evidence: ehpc/inputs_stage2/neb_q1_production/staging_manifest.json:3-4 is an unmarked current record with submission_status BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT and says its q=+1 source is absent; :20-24 says the entry never described a real staging operation and was never backed by a q1 input.

results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md:1-12 asserts BOTH LEGS CONVERGED, and :27-28 says q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz and q1/q1_final_relaxed.extxyz close the input-source gap. The named initial endpoint exists at this commit and hashes to 7af20ebb7a069ea0ae3ca8cb3c3867aa3dc6be0a63338e4fb6644b9f0274a121.

The staging record and current production authority make incompatible current assertions about custody of the q=+1 input. The submitted F-022 fix commit bc98bda31b8aaf4836e38b815ed66f90ef341fd3 is not an ancestor of the audited commit.

reproduce: rg -n 'BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT|does not describe a real staging|never backed by a real q1 input' ehpc/inputs_stage2/neb_q1_production/staging_manifest.json && rg -n 'BOTH LEGS CONVERGED|closes the F-003' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md && test -f results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz && shasum -a 256 results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz

proposed_check: C-STATE-007 — resolve every current production-run authority to its staging manifest and named input paths; fail if an unmarked manifest says BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT, never staged, or absent input while the authority says the run completed, or if a stated-absent path exists. Fixture: retain this q1 manifest with the present production status.

findings.title: Canonical index omits the live XRD passivator-screen conclusions
evidence: RESULTS_INDEX.md:1-4 declares itself the one-row-per-question index of every current scientific conclusion. Its only XRD text at :99-102 is a generic independent-subproject pointer; it names no XRD question, conclusion, authority, or raw-data path.

xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md:1-22 and :66-148 is an unmarked current six-film result: it records VALID/PROVISIONAL/NOT COMPARABLE dispositions and current conclusions including P5 ~10% PbI2 (3.8x control) and P3 below detection. Neither RESULTS_INDEX.md nor xrd/README.md names PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md.
The live XRD conclusions are absent from the declared canonical index. The submitted F-023 fix commit bc98bda31b8aaf4836e38b815ed66f90ef341fd3 is not an ancestor of the audited commit.

reproduce: rg -n 'PASSIVATOR_SCREEN|P5|P3|Generations-0726|xrd/' RESULTS_INDEX.md xrd/README.md xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md; sed -n '99,102p' RESULTS_INDEX.md; sed -n '1,22p;66,148p' xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md

proposed_check: C-NAV-005 — require RESULTS_INDEX.md to contain one explicit current XRD/passivator row when an unmarked xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md exists; the row must name that authority and raw/results paths. Fixture: an index containing only the present generic xrd/ pointer with PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md retained must fail.
